verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs describe the Workflow Management editor for combining checks in a template. It can run checks conditionally, for example only when another check fails or a session is high-risk, or based on the user's country of origin. The product page also advertises a no-code editor to create and change verification flows. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that template edits go live without an engineering deploy or Link reintegration, in-depth documentation of the routing logic beyond a single summary sentence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
